Elena Milovanović ( Serbian Cyrillic : Елена Миловановић ; born 31 January 2001) [ 1 ] is a Serbian tennis player. Milovanović has career-high WTA rankings of No. 487 in singles, set on 8 April 2024, and No. 409 in doubles, achieved on 10 June 2024. Up to date, she has won 12 titles in doubles and two titles in singles on the ITF Women's Circuit . Milovanović was born in Kraljevo , [ 2 ] started playing tennis at the age of eight and resides in Čačak . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] She won Serbian national team championships with TC Novak for three years in a row, from 2020 to 2022. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] Milovanović also has represented Serbia in the Billie Jean King Cup , where she has a win-loss record of 1–4.
